claims.text: The term is used to distinguish a genuine process from superficial actions, such as simply identifying what is wrong with religion versus improving oneself (L6). It serves as a marker for personal transformation, representing the end point of deconversion or a broader life change (L8, L9). The speaker also uses it to define a specific 'space' or phase of intellectual and spiritual development (L12, L13).
